title: PlayerGuns - On-Foot Weapons (MP Compatible)
tag_line: Camera-aimed FPS guns for BeamNG Walking Mode, with BeamMP sync
author: schatz.r
message:
PlayerGuns adds three FPS-style on-foot weapons (Uzi, Thompson, AKM) usable in BeamNG's Walking Mode.

Architecture is adapted from AwesomeCarl & AgentY's 'player_weapon_2' mod, with additions for BeamMP multiplayer support: camera aim direction is published to electrics so it syncs to remote clients, and firing is gated to local-owned vehicles with remote replay via a synced fire-pulse counter.

Controls: set your own keybinds in Options > Controls (search 'PlayerGuns'). No defaults shipped to avoid clobbering existing user binds on vehicle context switches.

Equip flow: open Parts Manager on the unicycle, set Visual Meshes slot to 'PlayerGuns Armed (Invisible Body)' > Weapon > PlayerGuns Weapon System > Ammo > 100 Bullets.

UI: add 'Player Guns Crosshair' (center) and 'Player Guns Ammo' (bottom-right) via Ctrl+U.

Credits:
